about_the_game:
Blast Bebop is a compact action-incremental game with straightforward gameplay: dodge, shoot, collect tokens, and upgrade your talents. Your character grows stronger over time, and the controls become progressively easier, until enemies fill the screen and vanish like white flames on a CRT monitor.

The game avoids complex build strategies, demanding reflexes, or lengthy progression and failure penalties. Simply move your fingers and let the retro visuals and psychedelic music guide you through a relaxing, self-contained journey.

About the demo:

  • Features roughly the first 60 minutes of gameplay (actual playtime may vary).

  • Includes the core mechanics from the full game: dodging, shooting, and around 50 different upgrades. However, both upgrade and enemy variety are significantly reduced compared to the full release.

  • Comes with 5 original BGM tracks (the full version will feature more).

  • Save management is not available in the demo. To replay, you’ll need to manually delete your save data.
